description:
Hushfeed v0.63.0 has 98 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3 and 47.1.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It includes the changes developed in 0.62.0, which wasn't published separately.

## What's changed

* Mute feed videos adds a movable sound button without changing the phone's volume. Stay on the video in full screen keeps the full-screen viewer on the current video when it ends.
* Downloads can show progress, save a caption and source details beside a video, organize files by creator and offer an existing saved copy before downloading again. Storage and deadline failures now stop multi-file saves consistently, and interrupted sticker writes remove their unfinished output.
* Feed limits leave profile grids and your own posts intact. Caption-language filtering has its own setting.
* Feature Gate Lab uses the installed TikTok build's gate list. Its compact layout leaves more room for results, and a reviewed 47.1.3 preset restores See translation. Failed structured edits retain their draft.
* Budget changes and settings checklists save together, with recoverable choices when storage fails. Failed exports clean up the file they created. Undo respects Android's requested time to act, and the Calm feed card fits larger text in both themes.
* Diagnostics remove credentials and identifiers before writing to logs or crash files. Ghost mode also guards story play reports and shows local reporting state or a failed check beside its switch. This still does not prove that TikTok omits you from a story's viewer list.
* Release receipts now bind the bundle to its clean source commit and build inputs.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/v0.63.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list.

## Checked

* 2303 runtime tests passed and 454 patch tests passed. Both Android lint checks passed.
* All 98 patches applied to both supported APKs. Resource checks passed, with no unexpected manifest changes. The attached release receipt records the exact bundle and each target's result.
* The audit candidate ran on a physical Galaxy S22. Settings checks covered both themes, 200% text, budget edits, checklists, backups and Lab export. The original installation and saved preferences were restored afterward.

Two-account Ghost verification and the reported LIVE, Fold, memory and split-APK cases remain open.

## Install

Use Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source, select the TikTok 47.0.3 or 47.1.3 APK, then patch and install it. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

`patches-0.63.0.mpp` is the patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` includes checksums for the bundle and its release receipt.
